sport.title: Toni Nadal shares theory on why so many players are getting injured after speaking to Roger Federer
paras: Many top men's tennis players have missed matches this year because of injuries. Carlos Alcaraz hurt his wrist in April and returned in September. Jannik Sinner last played in July, in the Wimbledon final.

Their absences gave Alexander Zverev a chance to rise to world number one. He also won his first two major titles. Sinner had won the Australian Open in 2024 and 2025, and may miss the 2027 event. When stars are away, other players get chances to win.

sport.title: November 27, 2011: The day Roger Federer won a then-record sixth ATP Finals title
paras: Every day, Tennis Majors takes you back to one of the biggest moments in tennis history. On November 27, 2011, Roger Federer and Jo-Wilfried Tsonga clashed for the eighth time in the season

On this day, November 27 in 2011, Roger Federer defeated Jo-Wilfried Tsonga (6-3, 6-7, 6-3) to claim a record sixth crown in the ATP Finals in London. After he finished 1998 as world No 1 in juniors, Federer performed well in his first professional matches: in his five first main tour appearances in 1998-1999, he reached the quarter-finals three times, in Toulouse, Marseille and Rotterdam.

sport.title: He is the only player to beat Jannik Sinner in the Davis Cup but now doesn’t even have a ranking
paras: Jannik Sinner has lost only one singles match in the Davis Cup, a tennis competition between countries. That defeat came in 2023. Since then, he has won nine matches in a row, playing alone and in pairs. The player who beat him now has no world ranking, a list comparing tennis players.

Sinner last played in the Davis Cup in 2024, helping Italy keep the title. He missed the event last year and cannot play this time because he is recovering from surgery. He had a knee injury and ended his season early after winning Wimbledon. Without him, Italy cannot include one of its key players.

sport.title: What happened the last time Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner did not compete at a Grand Slam event
paras: The Italian superstar suffered a debilitating knee injury in the lead-up to the US Open and has been absent from the Tour ever since. Sinner underwent knee surgery earlier this week and is now set to spend significantly more time on the sidelines.

“We’ve been in regular touch with Jannik’s team and they’ve confirmed he won’t be joining us for the Australian Open in January following his recent surgery,” Tennis Australia chief Andrew Abdo said in a statement to AFP on Thursday. Tennis fans are now set to witness four consecutive Grand Slam events without the presence of both Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner .

sport.title: Andrey Rublev shares his honest opinion about Mirra Andreeva as both a tennis player and person
paras: Andrey Rublev experienced playing alongside Mirra Andreeva at the US Open this year. Andreeva has won Roland Garros and the WTA Finals this year, in what has been a big breakthrough season for the Russian teenager, who has a big opportunity to become world number one at the start of the 2027 season.

Although they had played an exhibition set together before, the US Open mixed doubles was the first time Andreeva and Rublev had played together in a professional setting. Andreeva and Rublev made it all the way to the semi-finals, beating two-time defending champions Sara Errani and Andrea Vavassori en route, before they were beaten by eventual champions Karolina Muchova and Jakub Mensik .

sport.title: Every player Jannik Sinner defeated in a Masters 1000 final in 2026 as the season ends
paras: After winning a second consecutive Wimbledon title , Sinner decided to forego competing in the Canadian Open. Sinner was due to make his return in August, but suffered a knee injury in the buildup to the US Open.

Sinner missed the rest of the season and is now set to spend a significant period of 2027 on the sidelines after undergoing knee surgery . Prior to the knee issue, Sinner was having a superb season – evidenced by his five consecutive Masters 1000 titles. Sinner secured his first title of the year in Indian Wells, beating Daniil Medvedev in the final.
